info.name: NL Design System Theme
info.summary: Apply Dutch government design tokens (NL Design System) to Nextcloud
info.description:
This app allows you to apply NL Design System design tokens to your Nextcloud instance.
It ships 43 token sets covering the Dutch national government (Rijkshuisstijl), the large-city design systems (Utrecht, Amsterdam, Den Haag, Rotterdam), a broad set of community-maintained municipality and organization brands, and La Suite numérique (Cunningham design system) for European sovereign-workplace (MinBZK/mijn-bureau EDIC) bundles. Configure which token set to use in the admin settings.
Fira Sans and Inter (both SIL Open Font License 1.1) are bundled and self-hosted — no external CDN — so the theme works inside Nextcloud's default Content-Security-Policy and on air-gapped government instances.
Free and open source under the EUPL-1.2 license. Gratis en open source onder de EUPL-1.2 licentie.
